## Activity

During July 2026, Market Eye Clinic completed 364 captures. Activity was delivered through the clinic’s planned session arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 364 captures completed, 81 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 22.3%. The result indicates that a substantial proportion of captured images could not be used for grading. The image-quality outcome should therefore be considered when reviewing the overall performance for the month and when planning any local follow-up or service improvement activity.

## Grading

A total of 86 results were graded referable during July 2026. The median grading lag was 1 day. This indicates that the typical interval between capture and completion of grading remained short for the reporting period. The referable results should continue through the established clinical review and referral arrangements. Overall, the report records 364 captures, with image usability and grading outcomes documented separately to support operational monitoring at Market Eye Clinic.
